qs.html: Why is the library closed in early July?
opts: Students are on a school trip.
Workers are putting in new bookshelves.
The books are being moved to another school.
qs.exp: 公告第一句說 because workers are putting in new bookshelves，工人在裝新書架。
qs.passage:
Greenhill Junior High Library — Summer Notice

The library will be closed from July 1 to July 14 because workers are putting in new bookshelves.

From July 15 to August 25, it will be open Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m. Students can borrow up to 5 paper books at a time and keep them for 3 weeks. Late fees for paper books: NT$5 per book per day.

Can't come to the library? Try our e-book app, ReadGo! Log in with your student number and borrow up to 3 e-books. E-books go back by themselves after 14 days, so you never pay late fees.

qs.html: Amy borrows 5 paper books on July 20. By which day should she return them to avoid late fees?
qs.exp: 紙本書可借 3 週（21 天），7 月 20 日加 21 天是 8 月 10 日。

qs.html: How many students use their phones for more than 3 hours on a school day?
qs.exp: 超過 3 小時包括 3–5 hours（56 人）和 More than 5 hours（24 人），共 80 人。
qs.passage:
A survey asked 200 students at Lin's school: “How many hours do you spend on your phone on a school day?”

Less than 1 hour: 30 students　1–3 hours: 90 students
3–5 hours: 56 students　More than 5 hours: 24 students

Most students said they use their phones for watching videos (62%), chatting with friends (21%), and studying (11%).

The school nurse, Ms. Chen, says, “Teenagers need 8 to 10 hours of sleep. If you use your phone in bed, the light makes it harder to fall asleep. Try putting your phone outside your bedroom one hour before bedtime.”

qs.html: What do most students use their phones for?
qs.exp: watching videos 占 62%，是最多的用途。文中沒有提到玩遊戲。

qs.html: Why did Jenny write to FitWear?
opts: She got shoes in the wrong size.
qs.exp: 她訂 size 7，收到的卻是 size 8，尺寸錯了。
qs.passage:
From: Jenny Wu　To: FitWear Customer Service
Subject: Wrong size

Hi, I ordered a pair of running shoes (size 7) on your website on May 3, but the shoes I got on May 6 are size 8. I need them for a race on May 20. Could you send me the right size before then? I've put the shoes back in the box. Please tell me how to send them back.
Jenny

—

Dear Jenny,
We're sorry! We'll send you a size 7 pair today, and it should arrive in two to three days. You don't need to pay for anything. When the delivery person brings your new shoes, just give him the box with the wrong pair.
FitWear Customer Service (May 8)

qs.html: When will Jenny probably get the new shoes?
qs.exp: 客服 5 月 8 日回信說今天寄出，二到三天會到，所以大約 5 月 10～11 日。

qs.html: If it rains on October 18, when will the clean-up be?
qs.exp: 海報說 If it rains, we'll do it on Sunday, October 19。10 月 10 日是報名截止日。
qs.passage:
Join the Blue Coast Beach Clean-up!

Date: Saturday, October 18 (If it rains, we'll do it on Sunday, October 19.)
Time: 8:00–11:00 a.m.
Meet at: the bus stop in front of Sunny Beach
Bring: a hat, a water bottle, and gloves. We'll give you trash bags.

Last year, 150 volunteers picked up 600 kg of trash. Over half of it was plastic: bottle caps, straws, and food boxes.

This year, every volunteer who brings their own water bottle gets a free T-shirt! Sign up online by October 10.

qs.html: What do volunteers NOT need to bring?
qs.exp: 主辦單位說 We'll give you trash bags，垃圾袋會提供。帽子、水壺、手套要自己帶。

qs.html: Why did Grandpa have trouble reading the newspaper?
qs.exp: 第一句說 Grandpa started to lose his eyesight，視力變差。
qs.passage:
Last year, Tom's grandpa started to lose his eyesight. Reading the newspaper, his favorite morning activity, became hard. Tom found an app that reads words out loud: Grandpa just points his phone's camera at the page.

At first, Grandpa didn't want to use it. “Phones are for young people,” he said. So Tom made a plan. Every Sunday, he sat with Grandpa and practiced with him for half an hour. After a month, Grandpa could use the app by himself.

Now he even uses it to read the bus timetable and the labels on his medicine. “My grandson gave me my newspaper back,” he tells his friends.

qs.html: What did Grandpa think of the app at first?
opts: He didn't want to use it.
He asked Tom to find it.
qs.exp: At first, Grandpa didn't want to use it. 他覺得手機是年輕人用的。
